about: Every export of every entry point of @integraledger/lcp belongs to exactly one unit below. A unit may group a family's codec, its types and its helpers. Each unit states its use: what it does for anyone who implements or uses the Legal Context Protocol, with no other software than a protocol's own stock clients and servers. Each names, in fixedBy, the published specification or profile that fixes its behaviour; a profile named by its file is in lcp/profiles/, and a vector file in lcp/vectors/. An export with no use for such a user does not belong in the package. `exports` maps each entry point, `.` for the package root, to the names it exports into the unit. `pending` lists exports a unit may name before the package exports them, each with its reason; once the package exports one, it leaves that list. node scripts/check-public-units.mjs checks this file against the built package.

units.use: Assembles an ATR and hashes its exact bytes, compares two hashes, and writes and reads the hash's string, structured and raw forms, so a buyer, a seller and an auditor compute and compare the same H.
units.fixedBy: The Legal Context Protocol's record and hash rules; core-vectors.json.

units.use: Computes from H the value an agreement carries in H's place on a pairing whose single-use value is H itself or H's low bits, so any resource server that offers an agreement and a payment of one pairing under one H keeps the two acts from sharing a single-use value, and any holder of the ATR compares what recover reads from an agreement's transaction with the value it computes from its own H.
units.fixedBy: read-status.md, rules 1, 2 and 27; core-vectors.json, agreementValue.

units.use: Tells whether a link is the https link the protocol requires, reading it as a browser reads a URL.
units.fixedBy: The Legal Context Protocol's https-link rule; the WHATWG URL Standard; Unicode IDNA (UTS #46).

units.use: Writes a JSON value in its canonical form and digests it, reads JSON with a bound on its depth, and reads and writes the base64 forms the protocols carry, each in its canonical form only.
units.fixedBy: RFC 8785; RFC 8259; RFC 4648; base64-platform.json.

units.use: Any caller tells a refusal from a result without a throw, and tells a refusal that a later read may answer differently from one that will not change.
units.fixedBy: docs/reference/refusals.md; docs/concepts/refusals.md.

units.use: Names the pairing that serves an option or a payment, and gives each pairing's facts and members: how it binds H, who signs it, the binding pattern it follows, and how a payment through it is read back.
units.fixedBy: Each pairing's profile or its protocol's specification; the Legal Context Protocol's binding patterns; docs/reference/pairings.md.

units.unit: The registry entry as data and its codec
units.use: The registry entry as data and its codec, typed per family as Codec<Presented, Ref, Reader, F>, F being one descriptor of the family's documents, offers, inputs and read types: any caller reads a pairing's facts (which signed field carries H, whether a payment through it is itself a public proof of H, what reading it back needs and how long a signed payment can stay payable, and the agreement payment it admits) and calls its members with no cast.
units.fixedBy: Each pairing's profile; the Legal Context Protocol's binding patterns.

units.unit: The read of a landed payment or agreement
units.use: What every pairing's status takes and answers, and what its recover takes: any seller, buyer or auditor holding an ATR reads a payment or an agreement back through its own reader, learns whether the act asked about landed, can still land, or can no longer land, and why a transaction that carries H is not that act; and reads H back from a transaction id with the option the ATR's binding slot holds.
units.fixedBy: read-status.md; read-status.json.

units.use: A resource server composing a challenge learns, before any payment exists, whether a payment through the pairing arrives already sent by the payer or is put on its rail by the payee.
units.fixedBy: Each protocol's specification for each credential type; broadcaster.json.

units.unit: The MPP challenge id from H
units.use: Any MPP server or client derives a challenge's id from H, and reads H back from the id.
units.fixedBy: mpp-charge.md.

units.use: Any server sizes its own limits from the largest input the package's decoders accept, a card agent's signed headers and Verifiable Intent layers among them.
units.fixedBy: Each bound's stated reason, against the format it bounds: MPP's challenge and credential, x402's accepts and request commitment, JSON, the ATR's link, TAP's signed headers and Verifiable Intent's layers; decoder-caps.json.

units.use: Any A2A agent declares the LCP extension in its Agent Card, places H and the link in a task's metadata, and reads them back.
units.fixedBy: a2a-legal-context-v1.md; the A2A specification.

units.use: Any ACK seller carries H as its Payment Request's id, and any buyer or auditor reads it back from the request and its receipt.
units.fixedBy: ack-payment-request.md; ACK's Payment Request.

units.use: Any ACP merchant carries H as the checkout session's id, with the link in the session's metadata, and any agent carries it in a delegate-payment allowance.
units.fixedBy: acp-checkout-session-id.md; the Agentic Commerce Protocol; charge-reference.json.

units.use: Any AP2 merchant places H in the checkout JWT that the buyer's Checkout Mandate commits to, and any merchant or auditor reads it back from the mandate as presented, finding the checkout by its own id.
units.fixedBy: ap2-checkout-mandate.md; AP2 v0.2; sd-jwt.json.

units.unit: AP2 checkouts paid with AP2's x402 credential
units.use: Any AP2 merchant paid through AP2's x402 payment credential reads H from the checkout mandate, checks the credential's authorization is bound to its payment mandate chain as AP2's payment processor does, and keys its record of the payment by the authorization's signer and nonce.
units.fixedBy: ap2-checkout-mandate-x402.md; AP2 v0.2 and its reference x402 flow.

units.use: Any agent or merchant on a card checkout carries H through Visa's Trusted Agent Protocol, Mastercard Agent Pay, Visa Intelligent Commerce, Mastercard's Verifiable Intent or the plain checkout, and a seller keys its record of a card payment by its own processor reference.
units.fixedBy: card-visa-tap.md; card-mastercard-agent-pay.md; card-visa-vic.md; card-mastercard-vi.md; card-seller-reference.md; card.json; charge-reference.json.

units.use: Any UCP business carries H and the link as a legal_context entry of the checkout response, and any platform builds the checkout JWT an AP2 mandate commits to from the business's detached signature, and reads H back from it.
units.fixedBy: ucp-checkout-legal-context.md; ucp-payment-handler-x402.md; UCP; charge-reference.json.

units.unit: UCP checkouts completed by a platform-signed request
units.use: Any UCP platform that signs its requests writes H into the request that completes the checkout, and any business reads H back from that request once its Content-Digest is the body's, under the platform's signature UCP has it verify.
units.fixedBy: ucp-checkout-agent-signed.md; UCP's message signatures (RFC 9421, RFC 9530).

units.use: Any LCP seller publishes, and any buyer reads, /.well-known/legal-context.json.
units.fixedBy: The Legal Context Protocol's discovery document; discovery.json.

units.unit: x402 documents and the request commitment
units.use: Any x402 server and client reads and writes the v2 documents and the legalContext extension, and anyone reproducing H computes the request commitment the ATR's binding slot holds, of an HTTP request, with the header fields a resource server names, each by its name and the digest of its value, or of an MCP tool call.
units.fixedBy: The x402 v2 specification; x402-request-commitment.md; docs/guides/x402.md.

units.use: Every x402 server and client writes and reads PAYMENT-REQUIRED, PAYMENT-SIGNATURE and PAYMENT-RESPONSE as the specification and its stock clients do, every extension carried as it is.
units.fixedBy: The x402 specification's HTTP transport; x402-headers.json.

units.use: Any buyer's client on an EVM chain builds an x402 payment that binds H, and any server checks it before anything moves and reads it back.
units.fixedBy: x402-exact-eip155-eip3009.md; x402-exact-eip155-permit2.md; x402-exact-eip155-erc7710-salt.md; x402-exact-eip155-erc7710.md; x402-upto-eip155-permit2.md; x402-auth-capture-eip155.md.

units.unit: Circle Gateway's batched payment on eip155 chains
units.use: Any buyer's client signs Circle Gateway's batched authorization for an x402 option with the ATR hash as its nonce, after the sale's agreement is recorded on the same network, and any resource server reads the hash and the signer back before it hands the payment to Circle.
units.fixedBy: x402-exact-eip155-gateway-batched.md.

units.unit: EVM signing and the transfer's identity
units.use: Any EVM buyer's client builds the typed data a payer signs, and any reader identifies the transfer a payment made.
units.fixedBy: EIP-3009; EIP-712; Permit2; the x402 eip155 profiles.

units.unit: ERC-7710 delegations and the payments escrow
units.use: Any server reads an ERC-7710 permission context and the salt that commits to H, and anyone using the commerce-payments escrow computes a payment's hash and finds its authorization.
units.fixedBy: ERC-7710; x402-exact-eip155-erc7710-salt.md; x402-auth-capture-eip155.md.

units.use: Anyone reading an EVM payment back finds it, learns whether it landed, can still land or can no longer land, and reads H back from the settlement transaction alone.
units.fixedBy: EIP-3009; Permit2; Ethereum JSON-RPC; the x402 eip155 profiles.

units.use: Any Tempo buyer or seller builds and reads the transaction's calls, the TIP-20 memo transfer, the channel reserve's ids and the account keychain's key authorizations, and any holder of an ATR reads H back from a key authorization's witness.
units.fixedBy: Tempo's transaction and TIP-20 specifications; mpp-session-evm-tempo.md.

units.use: Any MPP server and client reads challenges as the stock clients read them, places H in a challenge and checks that a challenge is bound to it, names the request member a pairing writes H into, and answers a refusal in MPP's problem types.
units.fixedBy: The MPP specification; mpp-charge.md; mpp-challenge.json.

units.use: Any buyer's agent that has made an agreement returns to the resource server with H, and the sale's return value where it has one, in the Legal-Context header, and any resource server reads it; any buyer reads which charge options an agreement option serves.
units.fixedBy: legal-context-return.md; RFC 9651; legal-context-return.json.

units.use: Any MPP resource server that already runs an x402 facilitator settles an evm authorization or usdc EVM credential through it, as x402's exact EIP-3009 payment and requirements.
units.fixedBy: mpp-charge.md, rule 12; x402's exact scheme on EVM; mpp-x402-mapping.json.

units.use: Any MPP seller offers, and any buyer's client pays, a charge whose payment carries H or its commitment, and any server reads the payment back; on Tempo, builds and checks the attribution memo the stock MPP libraries write.
units.fixedBy: mpp-charge.md; mpp-charge-tempo-split-memo.md; mpp-charge-solana.md; mpp-charge-usdc-stacks.md; mpp-charge-nearintents.md; each method's MPP draft.

units.use: Any server tells a channel's opening from a later credential and holds a later credential to its channel; a buyer's client builds a later payment within its channel; any holder of a subscription's ATR finds a collection made under the key the payer authorised over H.
units.fixedBy: The MPP session and subscription drafts; mpp-session-evm-tempo.md; mpp-session-hedera-solana-xrpl.md; mpp-subscription-solana.md.

units.use: Any buyer's client checks an invoice before paying it, and any server checks that the invoice the seller's node signed carries H.
units.fixedBy: BOLT 11; x402-exact-lnbtc.md; MPP's Lightning charge and session drafts.

units.use: Any resource server offers x402's exact scheme on Lightning with the ATR committing the invoice's payment hash, checks a presented proof by x402's validation and the preimage check before it serves, and any buyer's client makes x402's checks of the invoice before it pays; a settler's /settle for the scheme runs the same validation.
units.fixedBy: x402's scheme_exact_lnbtc.md; BOLT 11; x402-exact-lnbtc.md.

units.use: Any Solana buyer's client builds the transaction a payer signs with H in its one Memo instruction, and any server decodes it and checks that Memo before it is relayed.
units.fixedBy: The Solana transaction format and Memo program; x402's exact scheme on Solana; mpp-charge-solana.md.

units.use: Any buyer or seller opens, pays within, and reads the close of a Solana payment channel, and signs and checks a session's authorisation.
units.fixedBy: MPP's Solana session draft; mpp-session-hedera-solana-xrpl.md.

units.use: Anyone reading a Solana payment back finds it, learns whether it landed or can no longer land, and reads H back from the landed transaction.
units.fixedBy: x402's exact scheme on Solana; mpp-charge-solana.md.

units.use: Any x402 buyer's client on Solana pays an exact or upto option with H in the Memo it signs, and any server checks it.
units.fixedBy: x402's exact and upto schemes on Solana.

units.use: Any XRPL buyer's client signs a Payment whose InvoiceID carries H, any server checks the signed blob, and anyone reads the payment, or a payment channel's opening, claim and close, back.
units.fixedBy: The XRP Ledger's Payment and PayChannel transactions; x402's exact scheme on the XRP Ledger; mpp-session-hedera-solana-xrpl.md.

units.unit: x402 upto on the XRP Ledger
units.use: Any x402 resource server that takes x402's upto scheme on the XRP Ledger after an agreement on the same network reads the presented payment's channel and payer, refuses an option a payment channel cannot pay, and reads the channel's create back from the ledger, so it and any auditor learn which account opened the channel to the payee, and when.
units.fixedBy: x402's upto scheme on the XRP Ledger; x402-upto-xrpl.md; x402-upto-xrpl.json.

units.use: Any buyer and seller using x402's batch-settlement bind one ATR to a channel: on EVM as the channel configuration's salt, on Solana in the opening's Memo, and on Cloudflare in each request's echoed extension.
units.fixedBy: x402-batch-settlement-eip155.md; x402-batch-settlement-cloudflare.md; x402's batch-settlement scheme.

units.use: Any Stellar buyer's client builds the Soroban transfer a payer signs and derives its muxed address, and any settler, seller or third party recomputes that address and reads the payment back.
units.fixedBy: Stellar's Soroban token interface (SEP-41) and muxed accounts; x402's exact scheme on Stellar.

units.use: Any settler or resource server validates a Hedera transfer whose signed memo carries H, and anyone reads it back from the Mirror Node.
units.fixedBy: Hedera's transaction format and Mirror Node API; x402-exact-hedera.md.

units.use: Any buyer and seller of a Hedera session compute its channel's id, sign and check its vouchers, and read its opening and close.
units.fixedBy: MPP's Hedera session draft; mpp-session-hedera-solana-xrpl.md.

units.use: Any Aptos seller advertises H in the challenge, and anyone holding the ATR finds the payer's transfer by its sender and sequence number and identifies it by what the payer signed.
units.fixedBy: x402's exact scheme on Aptos; the Aptos REST API.

units.use: Any Algorand buyer's client builds an asset transfer whose note is H, any server checks it before it is relayed, and anyone holding the transaction id reads H back.
units.fixedBy: x402-exact-algorand-note.md; the Algorand Indexer API.

units.use: Any Cardano buyer's client builds a transaction whose signed body commits to H as a CIP-20 message, on x402's address method or its two lock methods, any server checks it and prices the smallest agreement by the ledger's minimum output, and anyone reads the payment through its own indexer, by the input it spends and the payer's credential, or reads H back from the included transaction.
units.fixedBy: x402-exact-cardano.md; CIP-20.

units.use: Any Casper buyer's client builds the CEP-3009 authorization whose nonce is H, or its agreement value, any server checks it, anyone reads the payment back through a node by the token's record of the nonce, with lcp's bounds on that read, and anyone reads the carried value back from the executed call.
units.fixedBy: x402-exact-casper.md; CEP-3009.

units.use: Any Concordium buyer's client builds the one transfer whose memo carries H, any server checks it, and anyone reads H back from the finalized transfer.
units.fixedBy: x402-exact-ccd.md.

units.use: Any NEAR buyer's client signs a delegate action whose ft_transfer memo is H, any relayer or server checks it, and anyone reads the payment through the payer's access key and the relayed transaction's receipts.
units.fixedBy: x402-exact-near-memo.md; NEP-366; NEP-141.

units.use: Any Polkadot Asset Hub buyer's client signs one extrinsic that transfers the asset and remarks H, any server checks it, and anyone reads it back.
units.fixedBy: x402-exact-polkadot-lcp-assets-remark.md.

units.use: Anyone reading a Stacks payment finds it by its origin and the nonce the origin signed through a Stacks Blockchain API, searches the origin's nonces for H, learns whether it landed and whether it is the payment presented, and reads H back from the mined transaction; the bounds size a reader's work.
units.fixedBy: SIP-010; mpp-charge-usdc-stacks.md.

units.use: Any Starknet buyer's client builds the SNIP-12 outside execution whose nonce carries H's low 250 bits, or its agreement value's, any server checks it, anyone reads the payment back through a node by the payer's nonce and the asset's Transfer events, with lcp's bounds on that read, and a holder of the ATR confirms H's low bits against the landed nonce.
units.fixedBy: x402-exact-starknet.md; SNIP-9; SNIP-12.

units.use: Any Sui buyer's client builds a programmable transaction holding H as an unused input, any server checks it, and anyone reads H back from the executed transaction, what it moved and to whom, and searches the payer's transactions for H through a GraphQL endpoint.
units.fixedBy: x402-exact-sui.md.

units.use: Any Tron buyer's client signs a TRC-20 transfer whose memo is H, any server checks it, and anyone reads it back by its transaction id and searches a node's blocks for H.
units.fixedBy: x402-exact-tron-lcp-trc20-memo.md.

units.use: Any TON buyer's client sends a Jetton transfer whose forward payload is H as a text comment, any server validates it before it is relayed, and anyone reads it back, reads whether it settled, and reads its lapse from the wallet's state and its linked list of transactions.
units.fixedBy: x402's exact scheme on TON; TEP-74; x402-exact-tvm.md.
